title: Omar's Friday and the open day

scenes.caption: Friday.
scenes.say: It is Friday. Omar goes to Jummah with Abbu.

scenes.caption: Wudu.
scenes.say: First they make wudu with clean water.

scenes.caption: Shoes.
scenes.say: They take off their shoes at the door.

scenes.caption: The mosque.
scenes.say: Inside, the mihrab shows the way to Makkah.

scenes.caption: Community.
scenes.say: After prayer, neighbours greet each other.

scenes.caption: A church.
scenes.say: On Saturday, Omar visits a church open day.

scenes.caption: Manners.
scenes.say: He walks quietly, listens and asks polite questions.

scenes.caption: Respect.
scenes.say: Every place of worship deserves respect.
